name: scalarTrig
description: The move's sine and cosine come from the client's scalar routines; before, from its paired one

name: landingBounceCorrection
description: A landing bounces off the block the move's collision boxes pick (slime 1, a bed 0.75), only after a fall of at least 0.08, and the landing tick's gravity is corrected; before, only slime under the feet bounced, at any speed

name: scaffoldingClimbFlag
description: A held jump in scaffolding stops climbing when the climbable-block flag the last move left is off; before, on the tick the move is about to cross into a cell without scaffolding

name: signedHeadYaw
description: player_auth_input's head_yaw is the yaw as it is (-180 to 180); before, wrapped into [0, 360) (bedrock-observer's recordings: yaw -90, head_yaw 270 through 1.18.0)

name: solidEntityOneWay
description: A solid entity (a boat) the player is inside makes it a one-way collider, its push out limited to 0.1; before, nothing changes and the player is pushed out of it whole (1.16.201's rider left onto its boat's top)

name: dismountSearch
description: A rider that leaves its vehicle looks for a free spot around it; before, a boat's rider steps off along its look (its body's height + 1 upward, absolute), 1.6 from the boat, onto whatever is there

name: dismountLift
description: A rider that leaves its vehicle stands 0.001 above the floor of the spot it found; before, on the floor

name: levitationFullRewind
description: A Levitation added or removed takes effect from the tick after its stamp however late it arrives; before, from no earlier than 4 ticks before the current one
